dedupeResult: The complete active pull-request repository search was checked separately for KUTX, Fresh On The Net and WRIR before creation and returned no existing route records. Canonical domains, normalized platform and station names, submission paths, public or protected Music Department contacts, window rules and delivery modes were compared. KUTX is stored once for its general Music Director route and specialty-show alternatives; Fresh On The Net is stored once for its weekly form and conditional Exile FM downstream option; WRIR is stored once for its protected Music Department route.
emailVerificationLevel: KUTX's music@kutx.org was confirmed as a plaintext, first-party, domain-matched and purpose-specific Music Director address. Fresh On The Net publishes del.owusu@gmail.com on its official submission page for a conditional Exile FM radio submission after first using the primary Fresh On The Net route; it is treated as an official-page-published conditional contact rather than a domain-matched primary inbox. WRIR presents its Music Department address through a protected first-party link; it was not decoded, guessed or stored. No SMTP, MX, catch-all or mailbox-level deliverability probe was performed.
safety: No email, message, form or submission was sent; no track, audio file, WAV link, streaming link, biography, social profile, metadata, radio edit, attachment, rights declaration or consent was supplied; no protected email address was decoded; no submission window, CAPTCHA, anti-bot, human-verification, cookie, login or platform control was handled or bypassed; no paid promotion or payment workflow was started; no contact was guessed; and no SMTP/MX/deliverability probing was performed.
